[[File:Sorebones chathead.png|left|60px]]
'''Sorebones''' are the surgical [[Zombie pirate]]s under the command of the evil and short surgeon [[Mi-Gor]]. After the player defeats [[Barrelchest]], the monks inform the player that they have escaped with Mi-Gor back into the ocean. Their name seems to be a parody of the term "sawbones", a slang name for a surgeon (or more generally a doctor) - the Sorebones are depicted wielding a saw.

Sorebones can be found in the church on [[Harmony Island]]. They must be fought during [[The Great Brain Robbery]] [[quest]] in order to collect the components needed for [[Dr Fenkenstrain]]. The Sorebones get replaced with [[Barrelchest]] by the end of the quest, but they reappear after the quest is completed.

Sorebones can occasionally be found at [[Manor Farm]], asking for help with a hard Farming Guild request.

They also drop the [[Zombie bone]] used in the [[Rag and Bone Man wish list]].
